name: runlight-monorepo
description: Runlight: privacy friendly web analytics that lives inside your app.

scripts.test: npm run check:dashes && npm test --workspaces --if-present && node --test deploy/contact/server.test.mjs && npm run test:scripts && node --import tsx scripts/php-assets.mts --check && node --import tsx scripts/python-assets.mts --check
scripts.build: npm run check:dashes && npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run php-assets && npm run python-assets
scripts.check: npm run check:dashes && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:php
